description: Export Zendesk search results in batches using cursor pagination. Use the response's after_cursor value as page_after to fetch the next page.

inputSchema.description: Request parameters for exporting Zendesk search results.

filter_type.description: The object type returned by the export query. Can be 'ticket', 'organization', 'user', or 'group'.
filter_type.title: Filter Type

include.description: Comma-separated list of sideloads to include in the response. Available sideloads depend on the search result types (e.g., 'users', 'organizations').
include.title: Include

page_after.description: Cursor token for fetching the next page of results.
page_after.title: Page After

page_size.description: The number of results shown per page (max 100).
page_size.title: Page Size

query.description: The search query string. Supports Zendesk query syntax for filtering by type, status, priority, etc. Example: 'type:ticket status:open priority:urgent' or 'assignee:me status:pending'.
query.title: Query

inputSchema.title: GetSearchExportRequest

name: get_search_export

GetSearchExportResponse.description: Response from Zendesk search export API with results and pagination.

facets.description: The facets corresponding to the search query
facets.title: Facets

meta.description: Metadata for the export query response
meta.title: Meta

results.description: Array of search results (may contain tickets, users, organizations, or groups as specified by result_type in each object)
results.title: Results

GetSearchExportResponse.title: GetSearchExportResponse

SearchExportLinks.description: Navigation links for search export pagination.

next.description: URL to the next page of results via cursor
next.title: Next

prev.description: URL to the previous page of results via cursor
prev.title: Prev

SearchExportLinks.title: SearchExportLinks

after_cursor.description: Cursor token for fetching the next page
after_cursor.title: After Cursor

before_cursor.description: Cursor token for fetching the previous page
before_cursor.title: Before Cursor

has_more.description: Whether more items are available to be returned
has_more.title: Has More

SearchExportResult.description: A single search result object from Zendesk export.

active.description: Whether the user is active (for user results)
active.title: Active

default.description: Whether this is a default object (for group results)
default.title: Default

external_id.description: External ID linking to records in another system
external_id.title: External Id

id.description: The ID of the result object
id.title: Id

organization_id.description: Organization ID associated with the result
organization_id.title: Organization Id

updated_at.description: Last update timestamp in ISO 8601 format
updated_at.title: Updated At

url.description: API URL for the result object
url.title: Url

verified.description: Whether the user is verified (for user results)
verified.title: Verified

SearchExportResult.title: SearchExportResult
